scope: Installed-wheel native Agent behavior with synthetic loopback Appium; not real platform or Android World qualification

policy.controlsFirst: No screenshots when current control semantics suffice for location, authorized action and requested-result verification
policy.visualFallback: Explicit image requests, unresolved visual questions, unexposed custom-drawn targets or inherently visual acceptance
policy.verification: Delivered matching image observations precede image-dependent actions and prove visual results; stable labels are not state-change evidence

attempts.failure: Mac2 control flow closed after reading an unchanged label, then created another session to verify state; existing one-session and pre-DELETE changed-state criteria failed. Three visual cases hit their targets but the normalizer missed delivered images because it read only content lists. The screenshot journal also discarded nested pixel identity; its narrow whitelist was corrected. Old reports were not rescored.

attempts.diagnostic: Bounded shape-only event capture established actual Copilot result.binaryResultsForLlm image delivery and mirrored result.contents blocks; result.content is a text summary. The diagnostic also retained a recoverable ModuleNotFoundError before subsequent image/action execution. No raw image payload or transcript is retained in this record.

checks.mypy: passed for 74 production and test files after an explicit event-fixture type annotation
independentReviews: Safety/image delivery: no remaining reportable findings

limits: All six final scenarios passed in one fresh run; prior failures remain failed observations.
This exercises actual Agent -> installed Skill -> stdio MCP -> official Appium Python Client -> synthetic W3C endpoint behavior.
Image delivery, matching pixels, action ordering, pointer hits and post-state evidence support the visual behavior; they do not prove general visual understanding.
The fixture qualifies full-frame 400x300 images and exact pixels across lossless PNG encodings, not cropped/scaled coordinate mappings.
No Appium Server, platform driver, physical device, emulator, simulator or Android World campaign was exercised.
No real signing, permissions, desktop screen-recording readiness, production-app coverage or benchmark improvement is claimed.
Temporary normalized run reports are local evidence, not durable release assets; this bounded record retains outcomes, report digests and limits.
No raw model transcript, user code, screenshots, image payload or credentials are retained here.
